title: Repeated prisoner's dilemma in pairs
summary: Players are paired. In every round both players of a pair choose to cooperate (C) or defect (D) at the same time, learn the other's move and their own payoff, and play again.

roles.name: row
roles.description: The first player of a pair.

roles.name: col
roles.description: The second player of a pair.

steps.name: pd_round
steps.description: Both players of a pair choose C or D without seeing the other's choice.

steps.name: round_counter
steps.description: The round is counted; after the last round the game ends.

repeats.what: The round repeats with the same pairs.
carries_over: Each pair's history of moves, visible only to that pair.

payoffs.description: The payoff table entry for the two moves, added up over rounds.
The payoff table entry for the two moves, added up over rounds.

invariants.name: pairs_are_private
invariants.statement: A player never learns anything about the moves in another pair.

assumptions.text: If a player does not move, the whole run stops (unless a default move is configured).
Players see the full payoff table and the round number before each move.
Players know the number of the current round but are not told how many rounds remain.
With fixed matching the pairs are (a, b) and (c, d), in the order the players are listed.
